external_collaboration.evidence_quote: Clinical partnerships, including a long-standing partnership for cardiac and stroke care with UMass Memorial Medical Center allows Day Kimball Hospital to offer a variety and level of care not typically seen in the community hospital setting.

Day Kimball Health (DKH) announced today the formation of The Ortho Group at Day Kimball Health and a new partnership with Ortho Rhode Island (Ortho RI). The expanded orthopedic practice serves patients at Day Kimball Healthcare Center, at 12 South Main Street in Putnam, CT, and now includes three advanced practice providers and four surgeons.
